Subject: Patent assertion notice re: BrightWave v. Redwood — immediate preservation request

Hannah,

Attached is a formal notice from Brightwave asserting that certain outputs generated when a customer used Redwood’s inference endpoint potentially infringe one of Brightwave’s patents (claim summary in the PDF). We are copying our IP team and litigation counsel.

Immediate asks:
- Confirm receipt and preservation of all logs and model artifacts for the account BW-4201 (customer: Sentinel Apps).
- Provide an initial list of engineers/owners who will be available for a technical call this week.
- Identify the contract path: which MSA/order form governs the Sentinel Apps integration and whether there is a 3rd-party vendor/subprocessor clause.

We have included a high-level evidence bundle (evidence_manifest.xlsx) and a redacted copy of the allegedly infringing output. We are available for a call tomorrow afternoon PST.

Respectfully,
Maria Alvarez
Counsel, IP Litigation
Brightwave Systems
Attachment: brightwave_claim_notice.pdf, evidence_manifest.xlsx

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 10:02:35 -07:00
Subject: RE: Patent assertion notice — intake, privilege and proposed response plan

Thanks Hannah — I’ll take point on legal triage. Initial instructions and asks for the intake team: 

1) Preservation and evidence collection (urgent)
- Export and preserve raw request/response payloads, model_id/version, API keys used, timestamps, and full session KV cache where available. Ops: tag these exports as PRIVILEGED-LAW and store in the secure evidence folder (link below).
- Pull infra logs correlating to BW-4201 for the last 12 months.
- Retain any customer-shared prompt templates or fine-tuning artifacts.

2) Privilege and communications
- Do not send substantive technical analysis to the external counsel without privilege marking. Use the intake channel and Legal-only drive folder.
- If a demo or supportive technical summary is needed, route through me and mark as "For Counsel Only" until further notice.

3) Contract path and claims assessment
- Ops/Product: provide the active MSA and order form for Sentinel Apps (ideally with executed signature page). Confirm whether there is any third-party IP passthrough or vendor indemnity clause.
- Procurement/Sales: confirm if Sentinel Apps installed any Redwood Marketplace connectors or third-party plugins that could be implicated.

4) Proposed response posture (subject to further review)
- We will seek to limit exposure to (a) outputs that reproduce a protected work, and (b) product components proven to materially incorporate the asserted claims.
- Initial ask of Brightwave: provide claim charts or mapping. Absent a clear mapping, propose a bilateral fact-finding call.
- Evaluate early whether this is a defense-control scenario vs. reimbursement; flag necessity of escrow/insurance involvement if litigation appears likely.

Deadlines:
- We must respond acknowledging receipt and preservation within 48 hours (I’ll draft).
- Technical evidence bundle due internally EOD Mon (2027-05-10).

Attachments for internal use: evidence checklist (I will upload to the shared drive).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/claims/BW-4201-evidence (Legal-only)
